transcript: Speaker A: जो भी बच्चा 'B' से शुरू होने वाले 10 English sentences बना देगा, उसको एक बड़ी चॉकलेट मिलेगी। [Any child who can make 10 English sentences starting with 'B' will get a big chocolate.] Speaker B: Mam, birds fly in the sky. Books are on the table. Boys play cricket. Bananas are yellow. Bus is coming. Brother is studying. Butterfly is colorful. Ball is round. Baby is sleeping. Or best teacher is you, Mam. Speaker A: अरे वाह बेटा! आपने तो 10 sentences एकदम fluently बना दिए। कहाँ से सीखा ये सब? [Oh wow, son! You made 10 sentences so fluently. Where did you learn all this?] Speaker B: English Seekho app से, Mam. [From English Seekho app, Mam.] Speaker A: English Seekho app? ये क्या है? [English Seekho app? What is that?] Speaker B: Mam, English Seekho app, specially English बोलना सीखने के लिए बनाया गया है। ये एक learning app है। यहाँ मैंने spoken English का show देखा, जो हिंदी में समझाकर English बोलना सिखाते हैं, छोटे-छोटे 2 से 5 मिनट के videos में। और Mam, सबसे मज़ेदार चीज़, वहाँ एक AI coach है जो 24 घंटे available है। मैं रात को homework के बाद उससे chat करके practice करता हूँ। गलत लिखता हूँ, सुधार देती है। 100 बार सुधार दिया, कभी नहीं बोली "तुमसे नहीं होगा"। coaching teacher जैसी नहीं है वो। Mam, English Seekho app की मज़ेदार videos ने मेरे YouTube पे उल्टे-सीधे cartoon videos देखने की आदत को एकदम छुड़वा दिया। English Seekho app पर मैंने spoken English के अलावा grammar, sentence formation, daily life English जैसे doctor के पास क्या बोलो, school में teacher से क्या पूछो, मेहमानों के सामने कैसे बात करो, सब कुछ 2 से 5 मिनट के छोटे-छोटे videos देखकर सीखा। [Mam, English Seekho app is specially made for learning to speak English. It's a learning app. Here I watched a spoken English show, which teaches English by explaining in Hindi, in short 2 to 5-minute videos. And Mam, the most fun thing, there is an AI coach available 24 hours. I practice by chatting with her after homework at night. If I write wrong, she corrects it. Even if corrected 100 times, she never said "you can't do it". She is not like a coaching teacher. Mam, English Seekho app's fun videos completely broke my habit of watching random cartoon videos on YouTube. On English Seekho app, besides spoken English, I learned grammar, sentence formation, daily life English like what to say at the doctor's, what to ask the teacher at school, how to talk in front of guests, all by watching short 2 to 5-minute videos.] Speaker A: अरे वाह बेटा! English Seekho app तो हर बच्चे को download करना चाहिए। आओ बेटा, अपनी chocolate ले लो आके। [Oh wow, son! Every child should download the English Seekho app. Come, son, take your chocolate.] Speaker C: तो install button पे click करो और English Seekho app download करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A school teacher rewards a young boy with a chocolate after he fluently recites ten English sentences starting with 'B'. The boy attributes his success to the English Seekho app, praising its short Hindi-to-English lessons and 24/7 AI coach. The ad ends with a call-to-action to install the app.
